method: Read actual main-page text and extract port/terminal, return day, shuttle, last service, clock-time and travel-minute candidates. Compare each HTML byte-for-byte with main to prevent any unauthorized content changes.
completion: Audit candidates only. Official operator schedule and berth/last transport verification remains pending until direct official evidence exists.
limits: No live timetable or booking availability assertions
No new articles, HTML changes, images, routes, SEO, canonical, robots, sitemap or KidsStay changes
No merge/deploy without required CI and separately authenticated Vercel Preview
